svg.title: Production has opinions: an incident log of problems found and fixed
svg.text: Things I’ve broken, chased down and fixed.
→ missing NAT route from the private subnet
→ traced through target health and logs
→ IAM trust relationship, found in CloudTrail
→ cluster access had to be granted explicitly
→ profiles cannot be edited in place; design adapted
→ container user IDs vs. the security policy
